rows.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.
rows.translation: Fem åbne greb bliver til fem steder at spille G og akkorder tæt på hånden.

rows.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
rows.translation: Alle durakkorder kan låne grebet fra åbent C, A, G, E eller D, flyttet op ad halsen. På vej op fra et af dem kommer grebene i rækkefølgen C A G E D, og hvert greb forbinder til det næste.

rows.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: C, A, G, E og D: de fem åbne greb, som alle durakkorder kan låne overalt på halsen.

rows.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
rows.translation: Går du op fra åbent G, er næste greb E-grebet: din G-barré på bånd 3. Grundtonen på streng 6 er samme G som i den åbne akkord.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
rows.translation: Åbent D flyttet fem bånd op er G. Finger 1 holder streng 4 ved bånd 5, hvor sadlen var før. Finger 2, 4 og 3 genskaber D-trekanten ovenover.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The D shape, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Where is the D shape's root?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
rows.translation: Grundtonen i åbent D er løs streng 4. Flyttet op holder finger 1 den: G på bånd 5. Streng 2, bånd 8 er også G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
rows.translation: E-grebet ved bånd 3 og D-grebet ved bånd 5 deler en tone: G på streng 4, bånd 5. Hold øje med den, når du flytter mellem dem.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
rows.translation: Åbent C flyttet syv bånd op er G. Finger 1 ligger over streng 3, 2 og 1 ved bånd 7, finger 2 tager streng 2 ved bånd 8, og finger 3 og 4 strækker til streng 4 og 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The C shape, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
rows.translation: Som i åbent C er C-grebets grundtone på…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
rows.translation: Grundtonen i åbent C er streng 5, bånd 3. Her holder lillefingeren den: G på bånd 10.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
rows.translation: Skub C-grebet ned til bånd 2, så er det D, med grundtone på streng 5, bånd 5. Navnet følger altid grundtonen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The A shape, and around again
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
rows.translation: Læg barré over streng 5 til 1 ved bånd 10 og finger 3 over streng 4, 3 og 2 ved bånd 12. Det er din A-barré, og det er G igen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
rows.translation: Efter A-grebet vender G-grebet tilbage ved bånd 12: åbent G en oktav højere. Derfra gentages de fem greb i samme rækkefølge.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
rows.translation: Hvilket greb kommer efter A på vej op ad halsen?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
rows.translation: Rækkefølgen går i ring: C, A, G, E, D, så C igen. Efter A kommer G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
rows.translation: Med CAGED behøver du sjældent springe. Omkring bånd 5 er G D-grebet, C G-grebet og D A-grebet. Tre akkorder, ét sted.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
rows.translation: Hvilket greb spiller C lige ved siden af G med D-greb?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
rows.translation: C med G-greb bruger bånd 5 og 8, lige hvor hånden allerede er.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
rows.translation: Samme idé virker længere nede: G som E-greb ved bånd 3, C som A-greb ved bånd 3 og D som C-greb ved bånd 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Lantern Hill er en Timbre Original: en lejrbålsfællessang på G, C og D. Spil omkvædet åbent, så ved bånd 5 og så ved bånd 3, så flytter samme sang rundt på halsen. Hele sangen er i Sange under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
rows.translation: Hvilket greb spiller C nær bånd 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
rows.translation: C med G-greb bruger bånd 5 og 8, lige ved siden af G med D-greb og D med A-greb.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
rows.translation: Intet nyt: G i alle fem greb og G, C og D ved bånd 3 og bånd 5. Sig grebets navn, når du lander.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · title

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.translation: Treklange på de øverste strenge: dur og mol, alle omvendinger og akkordfølger, der næsten ikke flytter sig.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · unit summary

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: En treklang er den mindste fulde akkord: grundtone, terts og kvint. På streng 3, 2 og 1 klinger treklange klart og lyst, og de virker overalt på halsen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.translation: Grundtone, terts, kvint: fra C springer du et bogstav over til E og så endnu et til G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.translation: Flyt den dybeste tone øverst, så får du en omvending. Med E nederst ligger C på bånd 9, 8 og 8. Med G nederst er det toppen af dit åbne C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.translation: Alle durtreklange på disse strenge bruger ét af tre greb, ét pr. omvending. Lær dem på G og D, så kan du finde enhver durakkord.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.translation: G på bånd 4, 3 og 3 har samme greb som…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.translation: Begge har tertsen nederst: ét bånd højere på streng 3, de to andre på samme bånd. Samme greb, fem bånd fra hinanden.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.translation: D på bånd 7, 7 og 5 har samme grundstillingsgreb som dit C ved bånd 5. Længere nede er bånd 2, 3 og 2 toppen af dit åbne D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.translation: En moltreklang er en durtreklang med tertsen ét bånd lavere. På disse strenge er A-mol på bånd 2, 1 og 0 toppen af dit åbne A-mol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.translation: Læg barré på bånd 5 over streng 3, 2 og 1, så har du A-mol med C nederst. Én finger, tre toner.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.translation: E-mol på bånd 4, 5 og 3 har B nederst. Det ligger lige ved siden af A-mol på bånd 5, så skiftet er lille.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.translation: Vælg omvendingen nærmest hånden, så flytter akkordfølgen sig næsten ikke. G, E-mol, C og D ligger alle mellem bånd 2 og 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.translation: Fra G på bånd 4, 3, 3 til E-mol på 4, 5, 3: hvilke toner bliver?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B på streng 3 og G på streng 1 bliver. Kun streng 2 flytter, fra D op til E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: De samme fire akkorder ligger også højere: G på bånd 7, 8 og 7, E-mol på 9, 8 og 7, C på 9, 8 og 8 og D på 7, 7 og 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Spil treklangens toner én ad gangen, så har du et arpeggio. Gennem en akkordfølge danner tonerne deres egen melodi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: En akkord spillet én tone ad gangen

rows.translation: En akkord slået an to gange

rows.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: De øverste toner går her G, G, G, F med kryds: næsten stille, mens akkorderne skifter under dem. En tone, som to akkorder deler, er en fællestone. Derfor lyder treklange så glidende.

rows.translation: Gik den øverste tone op eller ned?

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Roller Rink er en Timbre Original: retrodancepop på G, E-mol, C og D, dine fire treklange mellem bånd 2 og 5. Små greb på de øverste strenge lyder lyst og stramt, som en anden guitar. Hele sangen er i Sange under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: Runden i Roller Rink er et, seks, fire og fem i G. Hvilken akkord er seks?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Tæl op i G-dur: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Akkorden på 6 er mol: E-mol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Treklange fra øverste streng og ned

rows.translation: Intet nyt: dur- og moltreklange, deres omvendinger, G, E-mol, C og D to steder samt arpeggioerne. Hold hver bevægelse lille.

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: En maj-septim-akkord tilføjer tonen ét bånd under grundtonens oktav. Den gør en almindelig durakkord blød og drømmende. Åbent Cmaj7 er C med finger 1 løftet.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Cmaj7 er C plus hvilken tone?

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: Den store septim ligger ét bånd under grundtonens oktav: B, lige under C.

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Spil det lille F, men lad finger 1 kun trykke streng 2 ned. Løs streng 1, E, er den store septim til F.

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: En molseptimakkord tilføjer tonen to bånd under grundtonens oktav. Den lyder blødt, mellem mørkt og lyst. Am7 er A-mol med finger 3 løftet.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: finger 2 på streng 3, bånd 2, og finger 1 fladt over streng 2 og 1 på bånd 1. Em7: kun finger 2 på streng 5, bånd 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.translation: Am7 er A-mol plus hvilken tone?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.translation: Den lille septim ligger to bånd under grundtonens oktav: G, to bånd under A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5

Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.translation: Finger 1 holder streng 5 ved bånd 3 og ligger over til streng 1. Finger 3 tager streng 4, finger 2 streng 3 og finger 4 streng 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.translation: Dm7 er din A-mol-barré med lillefingeren løftet. D7 er A-barréen med finger 3 og 4 på streng 4 og 2. Begge får navn efter streng 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.translation: Dm7 ved bånd 5. Hvor er grundtonen?

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.translation: Som alle akkorder med A-greb får den navn efter tonen på streng 5.

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: Jazzens favoritskift: akkorden på toneartens anden tone, så den femte, så hjem. I C er det Dm7, G7 og Cmaj7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Spil E7-grebet med barré ved bånd 3: finger 1 over alle seks strenge, finger 3 på streng 5 og finger 2 på streng 3. Grundtonen er på streng 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er ii i C-dur?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Tæl op fra C: C er et, D er to. Septimakkorden bygget på D er D-mol-septim.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: Jazzguitarister lader ofte hver akkord klinge et øjeblik. Tryk ved anslaget, slip trykket lige efter, så begynder akkorderne at swinge.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text

Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Swingguitarister akkompagnerer med korte akkorder, der svarer bandet. Charleston-rytmen rammer første slag og det swingende og efter to og giver så plads.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: I G er to, fem, et Am7, D7 og Gmaj7. Am7 er E-mol-septim som barré ved bånd 5; Gmaj7 springer streng 5 over, med grundtone på streng 6, bånd 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Late Checkout er en Timbre Original: lo-fi i C på Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 og Am7. Det er en ii–V–I plus sjette trins akkord, som starter runden igen. Ledsag med dine septimbarréer og Charleston. Hele sangen er i Sange under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er V i Late Checkout?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Tæl op i C-dur: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. Septimakkorden på G er G7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
rows.translation: Intet nyt: maj-septim-, molseptim- og dominantseptimakkorder, åbne og med barré, samt ii–V–I i C og G. Hold akkorderne korte og swinget jævnt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?
rows.translation: Hvilken septim ligger ét bånd under grundtonens oktav?

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
rows.translation: G-dur i to oktaver ved bånd 2, skalatrin og akkorder samt dorisk og mixolydisk.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · unit summary

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Et halvtonetrin er ét bånd, et heltonetrin to. Alle durskalaer stiger hel, hel, halv, hel, hel, hel, halv. Det mønster giver dur sin lyd.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Sæt finger 1 ved bånd 2, og giv hver finger sit eget bånd op til bånd 5. Fra G på streng 6, bånd 3 stiger skalaen over streng 6, 5 og 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Streng 6: bånd 3 og 5, finger 2 og 4. Streng 5: bånd 2 og 3, finger 1 og 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Streng 5, bånd 5, så streng 4: bånd 2, 4 og 5. Hjem på G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.translation: Hvor ligger halvtonetrinene i en durskala?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Hel, hel, halv: første halvtonetrin er fra 3 til 4. Hel, hel, hel, halv: andet er fra 7 til 8.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: Samme position fortsætter: A, B og C på streng 3, D og E på streng 2, F med kryds og G på streng 1. Hånden flytter sig ikke.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Streng 3: bånd 2, 4, 5. Streng 2: bånd 3, 5. Streng 1: bånd 2, 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger spiller bånd 5 i denne position?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: Finger 1 er ved bånd 2, så bånd 5 tilhører finger 4, lillefingeren.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.translation: Joy to the World, arrangeret af Lowell Mason i 1839, åbner med G-dur-skalaen lige ned fra toppen. Du kender allerede alle tonerne.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.translation: Joy to the World i position

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Nummerér skalaen fra G: G er 1, A er 2 og så videre op til F med kryds, 7. Musikere bruger tallene til at tale om melodier og akkorder i enhver toneart.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Tæl op fra G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Stabl hver anden skalatone på hvert trin, så får du toneartens akkorder. Akkorder på 1, 4 og 5 er dur; på 2, 3 og 6 er de mol. I G: G, C og D, så A-mol, B-mol og E-mol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord bygges på 6 i G-dur?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: Sjette tone er E, og akkorder på 2, 3 og 6 er mol. Stabl E, G og B: E-mol.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Spil G-durs toner, men lad A være hjemme, så bliver skalaen molpræget. Denne lyd er A-dorisk, en modus af G-dur: samme position, ny starttone.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Start på A, streng 6, bånd 5, med finger 4, og gå op ad de samme bånd til A på streng 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Hvilken tone gør A-dorisk lysere end almindelig A-mol?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: Almindelig A-mol har F. Dorisk beholder G-durs F med kryds: et lyst punkt i en molskala.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Lad nu D være hjemme. G-durs toner fra D til D danner D-mixolydisk: en durskala med septimen ét bånd lavere. Den findes overalt i folk, rock og spillemandsmusik.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Fra D på streng 5, bånd 5, op gennem samme position til D på streng 2, bånd 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D-dur har C med kryds. D-mixolydisk har…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
rows.translation: Mixolydisk sænker septimen ét bånd, så C fra G-dur bliver dens karaktertone.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
rows.translation: Enhver tone i durskalaen kan være hjemme. Fra G er den dur, fra A dorisk, fra D mixolydisk, fra E almindelig mol. Samme bånd, forskellige stemninger.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Flyt din molpentatone boks fra bånd 5 ned til bånd 2, og lad A være hjemme: den bliver sød og durpræget. Det er A-dur-pentatonik: A, B, C med kryds, E og F med kryds.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Fra A på streng 6, bånd 5, så bånd 2 og 4 på streng 5 og 4 og A på bånd 2 på streng 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
rows.translation: Hvilke toner er med i A-dur-pentatonik?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
rows.translation: A, B, C med kryds, E, F med kryds
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
rows.translation: Fem toner fra A-dur-skalaen, med de to halvtonetrin udeladt. Molboksen ved bånd 5 rummer A, C, D, E og G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 4 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Denne boks ved bånd 2 er også F med kryds i molpentatonik, fra dens F med kryds. Tonen, du hører som hjemme, afgør, hvilken du spiller.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Countryguitarister elsker hammer-ons i denne boks: E til F med kryds på streng 4, A til B på streng 3. Slå første tone an, og lav hammer-on til den anden.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Streng 4: slå bånd 2 an, og lav hammer-on med finger 3 på bånd 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.translation: Glid op til C med kryds
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Lad nu finger 3 glide på streng 3 fra bånd 4 til bånd 6, B op til C med kryds, og glid så tilbage i boksen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Finger 3 på streng 3, bånd 4. Slå an, og glid så til bånd 6 uden at løfte.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.translation: Triller og slides ind i toner

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: En trille veksler hurtigt mellem to toner: ét anslag, så hammer-on, pull-off igen og igen. Hold den jævn, før du gør den hurtig.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Streng 3: bånd 2 og 4. Slå an én gang, og lav så hammer-on og pull-off med finger 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Start ét bånd under den ønskede tone, og glid op i den ved anslaget. Det er måltonen, der tæller: land den præcis på slaget.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Hvilken tone lander på slaget, når du glider ind i en tone?

rows.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
rows.translation: Slidet starter lige før slaget, så den tone, du sigter efter, lander præcis på det.

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: Begge bokse virker over blues i A. Durpentatonik ved bånd 2 lyder sødt; mol ved bånd 5 lyder råt. Gode musikere bevæger sig mellem dem.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
rows.translation: Hvilken boks lyder sødest over A7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: Durpentatonik rummer C med kryds, tertsen i A7. Molboksens C skurrer mod den, og den spænding er blues.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Stil et råt spørgsmål ved bånd 5, og svar sødt ved bånd 2. Flyt hånden på den lange tone, og land begge fraser på A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-4 “Sweet and sour” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Gode soloer trækker vejret. Spil en kort frase, hold omtrent lige så lang pause, og svar så. Stilheden giver de næste toner vægt.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After a two-beat phrase, how long might you rest?
rows.translation: Hvor længe kan du holde pause efter en frase på to slag?

rows.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
rows.translation: Spil en frase ens to gange, og ændr så kun slutningen. Lytterne hører gentagelsen og spidser ører ved ændringen.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
rows.translation: Hold hver lang tone, og vug den med et lille, jævnt skub og slip. Hold det smalt: tonehøjden skal svinge lidt, aldrig løbe væk.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-5 “Phrase like a singer” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Slow Motion Strobe er en Timbre Original: synthpop i A på F med kryds i mol, D, A og E. Boksen ved bånd 2 passer til hele runden: A-dur-pentatonik, som også er F med kryds i molpentatonik. Hele sangen er i Sange under Originaler.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Lyt til første akkord. Dur eller mol?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Over F sharp minor and D
rows.translation: Over F med kryds i mol og D

rows.source: E is E, G sharp and B. The box holds E and B but no G sharp, so lean on those two over E.
rows.translation: E er E, G med kryds og B. Boksen har E og B, men intet G med kryds, så læg vægt på de to over E.

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: De fleste sange bygges af få afsnit: vers, der fortæller historien, et omkvæd, der gentager hooket, og nogle gange et kontraststykke. Kender du formen, farer du ikke vild.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Omkvædet vender tilbage med samme ord og melodi. Det er den del, folk husker og synger med på.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Mange ældre sange bruger AABA: en melodi, samme melodi igen, et kontraststykke og så melodien én gang til. Hvert afsnit varer ofte otte takter; her varer de fire.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In AABA form, which section is the bridge?
rows.translation: Hvilket afsnit er kontraststykket i AABA-form?

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: Den letteste intro er sangens sidste linje, spillet før første vers. Den angiver toneart, tempo og stemning, og sangeren ved præcis, hvor stemmen skal ind.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-2 “Intros and endings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Why start with the song's last line?
rows.translation: Hvorfor starte med sangens sidste linje?

rows.source: To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
rows.translation: Slut ved at gentage sidste linje, ofte to gange mere, og lad sidste akkord klinge. Gentagelsen fortæller alle, at sangen slutter.

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
rows.translation: Arrangører løfter omkvædet ved at ændre guitarens spil. Spil verset blødt med fingrene, slå så akkorderne an i omkvædet, og de samme akkorder lyder pludselig større.

rows.source: Each section can add a little: a picked verse, a strummed chorus, then triads up the neck for the last chorus. Save your biggest sound for the end.
rows.translation: Hvert afsnit kan tilføje lidt: et vers med fingerspil, et omkvæd med akkordanslag og så treklange op ad halsen i sidste omkvæd. Gem den største lyd til slut.

rows.source: The solo uses G major pentatonic in open position: G, A, B, D and E. It follows the verse's chords and ends a beat early, so the singer can come back in.
rows.translation: Soloen bruger G-dur-pentatonik i åben position: G, A, B, D og E. Den følger versets akkorder og slutter et slag tidligt, så sangeren kan komme ind igen.

rows.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.

rows.translation: Nedslag, ned-op og ø-rytmen. Hold hånden i gang, og lad akkorderne komme til dig.

rows.translation: C D E F G A B C. Start på løs streng 3, og gå op over streng 2 og 1. Alle toner ligger i de første tre bånd.

rows.source: String 3 open and fret 2, then string 2 open and fret 1.

rows.source: How many different note names are in the scale?

rows.source: C to C is eight notes, but the top C repeats the first. Seven names, then they start again.
rows.translation: C til C er otte toner, men det øverste C gentager det første. Syv navne, så starter de igen.

Ukulele · Unit 4 · song uke-4-2 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune in 1824. It moves mostly by step, from one note to the next, on strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Beethoven skrev melodien i 1824. Den går mest trinvis fra tone til tone på streng 2 og 3.

rows.source: The opening: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.translation: Starten: E E F G, G F E D.

rows.translation: En fjerdedelsnode varer ét slag, en halvnode to, en helnode fire. Hold hver tone, til den næste starter.

rows.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
rows.translation: Giv C-skalaens toner numre, så kan du navngive akkorder med tal: C er I, G er V, A-mol er vi, F er IV. Denne rækkefølge går igen i utallige sange.

rows.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.

rows.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.

rows.translation: Stephen Foster skrev denne sang i 1848. Den tælles i to: 1 og 2 og. De fleste toner er hurtige ottendedele.

rows.translation: Læg finger 1 over streng 2 og 1 på bånd 1. Finger 2 går på streng 3, bånd 2, og finger 3 på streng 4, bånd 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord deler finger 1's plads på streng 2 med B med b?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.translation: F har også finger 1 på streng 2, bånd 1. Lad den blive, når du skifter.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · title

rows.source: D7: a barre and one finger
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Læg finger 1 over streng 4, 3 og 2 på bånd 2, og sæt finger 2 på streng 1, bånd 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: I G klarer akkorderne G, C og D7 det meste, med E-mol som mørkere farve. D7 trækker tilbage til G, som G7 trækker mod C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Læg finger 1 over streng 3, 2 og 1 på bånd 2, og ræk så finger 3 til streng 4, bånd 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: På hvilke strenge trykker både D og B-mol på bånd 2?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Begge akkorder holder bånd 2 på streng 3 og 2. Kun de yderste strenge skifter.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: I D bærer D, G og A7 sangen, og B-mol giver en trist akkord. A7 er én finger: streng 3, bånd 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Sangens akkorder er trin i tonearten: I, IV og V. Skifter du toneart, bliver tallene. I C er det C, F og G7; i G er det G, C og D7; i F, F, B med b og C7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er IV i F-dur?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Tæl op fra F: F, G, A, B med b. Fjerde tone er B med b.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Hvis en sang ligger for højt eller dybt at synge, så flyt den til en anden toneart. Samme tal, samme sang, bare bedre til stemmen.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er V i D-dur?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Tæl op fra D: D, E, F med kryds, G, A. A er femte tone, så A7 er V-akkorden.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Finger 2 på streng 3, bånd 2, finger 3 på streng 2, bånd 3 og finger 1 på streng 1, bånd 1. Streng 4 klinger løst.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: Familien i D-mol er D-mol, G-mol og A7. A7 trækker hjem til D-mol, som E7 trækker mod A-mol.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Intet nyt: B med b, D7, B-mol og G-mol samt tonearterne C, G, F og D. Først rene greb, så jævne anslag.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord er V i G-dur?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · title

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: Chunk, ø-rytmen med backbeat, swing og ragtimeakkorder, betoning i 3-3-2 og vals.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Et chunk er et anslag, der stoppes brat. Slå nedad, og lad håndkanten lande på strengene samtidig: et kort, tørt klik som en lilletromme.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Slå ned på 1, chunk på 2, ned-op på 3, chunk på 4. Chunkene ligger, hvor trommeslageren rammer lilletrommen.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: To og fire er backbeatet, hvor lilletrommen spiller. Et chunk dér giver anslaget trommeslagerens slagkraft.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · title

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Tag ø-rytmen, D, DU, UDU, og gør nedslaget på 2 til et chunk. Rytmen er uændret; groovet får et backbeat.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.translation: Hvilket anslag bliver til chunk i denne rytme?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: Slag 1 klinger, slag 2 klikker. Alt andet bliver, hvor det var i ø-rytmen.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · title

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: Swing deler hvert slag ujævnt: et langt nedslag, så et kort opslag. Sig hum-pty, dum-pty, mens du spiller. Det er svinget i gamle ukulelemelodier.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7, så hjem til C. Hver septimakkord trækker mod den næste, en lille kæde af spænding. Den drev utallige sange for et århundrede siden.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord trækker D7 mod her?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: D7 fører til G, og G7 fører hjem til C. Hver akkord forbereder den næste.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Spil jævne ned-op-ottendedele, men ram tre kraftigere: 1, og efter 2 og 4. Betoningernes afstand er 3, 3 og 2 ottendedele.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Tæl 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 gennem taktens otte ottendedele. Hvert 1 er en betoning.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: George Formbys split stroke på banjoukulele lægger de kraftige anslag de samme tre steder med enkeltstrenge imellem. Lær betoningen først.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: I tretakt slår du ned på 1, så ned-op på 2 og på 3: D, DU, DU. Læg vægt på 1, så vugningen er tydelig.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Hvor mange anslag fylder denne takt på tre?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Ned på 1, så ned-op på 2 og på 3: en plus to plus to.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Intet nyt: chunks, ø-rytmen med chunk, swing, 3-3-2-betoninger og vals. Hold hånden i gang, og lad betoningen tale.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: I swing deles hvert slag i…
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · title

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: Én finger pr. streng, rullende mønstre, vekslende tommelfinger og en melodi hentet fra akkorderne.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: Hvil tommelfingeren på streng 4, pegefingeren på streng 3, langfingeren på streng 2 og ringfingeren på streng 1. Hver knipser kun sin egen streng.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Tommelfinger, pegefinger, langfinger, ringfinger: streng 4, 3, 2 og 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Tommelfinger på 4, pegefinger på 3, langfinger på 2, ringfinger på 1: én finger pr. streng.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 4 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Fordi streng 4 er et højt G, går mønstret i zigzag: højt, dybt og så opad. Den glans er lyden af ukulele med fingerspil.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.translation: A-mol, F, C, G7 i ottendedele
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 7 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Knips streng 4, 3, 2 og 1, så tilbage på 2 og 3: tommelfinger, pegefinger, langfinger, ringfinger, langfinger, pegefinger. Seks toner fylder en tretakt.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger kommer efter ringfingeren på streng 1?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: Rullet vender øverst: ringfinger på streng 1, så langfinger på 2 og pegefinger på 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Land den nye akkord, når tommelfingeren starter næste takt. Fingrene ruller videre; kun grebet under dem skifter.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 7 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Nu vipper tommelfingeren mellem streng 3 og 4 på slagene, mens de andre fingre knipser streng 2 og 1 imellem. Det er ukulelens version af Travis-fingerspil.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Hvad gør tommelfingeren i dette mønster?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
rows.translation: Tommelfingeren holder pulsen med én tone på hvert slag, mens fingrene fylder hullerne.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 5 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 6 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · title

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: I akkordmelodi holder gribehånden akkorden, og du knipser melodien fra den. Hold F, så ligger C, F og A allerede under fingrene.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Hold F: løs streng 3, streng 2 ved bånd 1, løs streng 1. Sådan begynder Amazing Grace.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
rows.translation: Når melodien forlader akkorden, rækker du med en fri finger. Over F tager finger 3 G på streng 2, bånd 3 og løftes, når melodien vender tilbage.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Over B flat, where is the tune's D?
rows.translation: Hvor er melodiens D over B med b?

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, først trykt i 1918, er skabt til fællessang. På ukulele er den i G med G, C og D7 og et gospelpræget A med kryds på streng 1, bånd 1.

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A med kryds, B, så A og G.

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp udgav denne engelske ballade i 1906. I F bruger den F, B med b, C og C7, G-mol og D-mol, ofte to pr. takt. Knips akkorderne mellem versene, og lad dem klinge.

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: The water is wide: løs streng 3, F på bånd 1 to gange, G på bånd 3, så løst A.

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Mange takter skifter her halvvejs. Tæl verset i halvdele på to slag, én akkord hver, og skift på hvert andet klik.

rows.translation: Før første anslag tæller du højt i sangens tempo: en, to, tre, fire. Alle starter sammen i det tempo, du sætter.

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Misser du en akkord? Fortsæt anslagene, og fang den næste. En syngende forsamling følger pulsen, ikke hver tone.

rows.translation: Pulsen bærer alle. Drop om nødvendigt en akkord, aldrig rytmen.

rows.translation: Før sidste linje nikker du eller siger “sidste gang”. Sænk sidste linjes tempo lidt, og lad sidste akkord klinge.

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: Molly Malone blev trykt i 1876. Det er en vals: læg vægt på slag 1, og lad melodien vugge. I F bruger den F, G-mol, C7, D-mol og G7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: løs streng 3, F på bånd 1 fire gange, løst A, tilbage til F.

rows.translation: Streng 3 bånd 2; streng 2 bånd 1 og 4; streng 1 bånd 1.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Eighth-note rock, dotted rhythms, space, and a Motown-style line.
rows.translation: Rock i ottendedele, punkterede rytmer, luft og en basgang i Motown-stil.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 “Grooves” · unit summary
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · title
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Play a note on every count with your fingers taking turns. Even volume is the goal.
rows.translation: Tæl 1 og 2 og 3 og 4 og. Spil en tone på hver tælling med skiftende fingre. Målet er jævn lydstyrke.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Your eighth notes start to rush. What helps?
rows.translation: Dine ottendedele begynder at løbe. Hvad hjælper?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lock to the click and relax your hand
rows.translation: Følg klikket præcist, og slap af i hånden
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
