Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Vibrato is a small, even wave in pitch that makes long notes glow. The fingertip rolls slightly back from the note and returns, again and again, moved by the hand and arm.
rows.translation: Vibrato er en lille, jævn bølge i tonehøjden, som får lange toner til at gløde. Fingerspidsen ruller lidt tilbage fra tonen og vender tilbage igen og igen, bevæget af hånd og arm.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Vibrato can't rescue a note that's out of tune; it only colors one that's centered. Most players add it once their fingers land in tune without searching.
rows.translation: Vibrato kan ikke redde en falsk tone; det farver kun en tone, der rammer centrum. De fleste tilføjer det, når fingrene lander rent uden at lede.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When is a note ready for vibrato?
rows.translation: Hvornår er en tone klar til vibrato?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.translation: Når den er lidt for høj
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Set second finger on the A string. Keep the fingertip in place, soften the knuckle, and slowly rock your hand toward the scroll and back. Small and even. A teacher's eye helps here.
rows.translation: Sæt anden finger på A-strengen. Hold fingerspidsen på plads, blødgør knoen, og vip langsomt hånden mod snekken og tilbage. Småt og jævnt. En lærers blik hjælper her.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Now bow these without vibrato and center each one. That center is where vibrato starts.
rows.translation: Stryg nu disse uden vibrato, og find hver tones centrum. Det er dér, vibrato starter.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 6 · lesson vln-6-5 “Getting ready for vibrato” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler was in print by 1847. Fiddlers slur its quickest notes in pairs, which gives the tune its skip. Start slow and keep the pairs even.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler var trykt senest i 1847. Spillemænd binder de hurtigste toner parvis, så melodien hopper. Start langsomt, og hold parrene jævne.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Why do fiddlers slur quick pairs?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: It saves bow and adds a lilt
rows.translation: Det sparer bue og giver et sving
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It keeps the strings in tune
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A, G, F sharp, A on the E string: third finger, low 2, first, third.
rows.translation: A, G, F med kryds, A på E-strengen: tredje finger, lav 2, første, tredje.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · song vln-6-6 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · title
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put it all together: in-tune fingers, straight bows, slurs and dynamics. Start piano, grow through the middle, and finish forte.
rows.translation: Saml det hele: rene fingergreb, lige buestrøg, legato og dynamik. Start piano, voks gennem midten, og slut forte.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Warm up: fourth finger against the open strings, A and then E.
rows.translation: Varm op: fjerde finger mod de løse strenge, A og så E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 4 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 6 · challenge vln-6-7 “Recital: Ode to Joy” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Sit, bow and play in tune, from open strings to The Swan
rows.translation: Sid, stryg, og spil rent, fra løse strenge til Svanen
rows.context: Cello course · course subtitle
Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · title

rows.source: Sit, set the endpin, hold the bow, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Sid, indstil endepinden, hold buen, og spil løse strenge og din første sang.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 “Hello, cello” · unit summary
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · title

rows.source: From low to high the strings are C, G, D and A. C is the thickest and lowest. A is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Fra dyb til høj hedder strengene C, G, D og A. C er tykkest og dybest. A er tyndest og højest, og vi kalder den streng 1.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
rows.translation: C er den tykkeste og dybeste streng. Strengene tælles fra A (1) til C (4).
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Knips streng 1, A, og lad den klinge.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
rows.translation: Nu den tykkeste streng, C. Lad den rumle.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-1 “Meet your cello” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · title
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
rows.translation: Sid nær stolens forkant med flade fødder og knæene fra hinanden, som om du let kunne rejse dig. Celloen hviler mellem knæene.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
rows.translation: Træk endepinden ud, til celloens overkant møder brystbenet, og C-skruen er nær venstre øre. Spænd skruen. En holder eller rem hindrer den i at glide.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
rows.translation: Celloen læner sig mod brystet, og knæene støtter let fra siderne.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
rows.translation: Sid rankt, og knips D, så G. Hold skuldrene løse.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-2 “Sit with your cello” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
rows.translation: Bøj tommelfingeren, og sæt spidsen, hvor froschen møder stangen, over for langfingeren. Lad alle fire fingre hænge over stangen, og lad hånden hænge tungt.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Sæt buen på D-strengen midt mellem stol og gribebræt. Træk langsomt mod højre.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Nu A-strengen. Flyt hele armen til dens niveau, og træk så langsomt.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
rows.translation: Fra dyb til høj: C, G, D, A. Hver streng ligger fem bogstavnavne over den forrige, et interval kaldet en kvint. Prøv: Citroner Giver Dej Appetit.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
rows.translation: Højre arm bestemmer, hvilken streng buen spiller. Hver streng har sit armniveau som trappetrin. Flyt hele armen, ikke kun hånden.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
rows.translation: Stryg C-strengen, så G. Lad armen falde til ro på hvert niveau.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · title

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
rows.translation: Orkestre stemmer efter A. Timbre viser i cent, hvor langt hver streng er fra sin tone; 100 cent er et halvtonetrin, klaverets mindste trin. Stem A, så D, G og C.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Nu D, G og C. Stem hver streng, stryg så, og hold tonen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · lesson vc-1-5 “Tune your cello” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Sid rankt med indstillet endepind, blødt buegreb og buen midt mellem stol og gribebræt. Spil nu alt fra denne del.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · challenge vc-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb ligger på D-strengen: løst D, første finger et heltonetrin op til E, tredje finger to heltonetrin op til F med kryds. Knips først, stryg så.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
rows.translation: Første finger på D-strengen, et heltonetrin op. Det er E.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Tredje finger et heltonetrin over første. Det er F med kryds.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
rows.translation: F med kryds, E, D, E, så F med kryds tre gange.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 1 · song vc-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Ét langsomt nedstrøg, så ét langsomt opstrøg på D. Hold lyden jævn helt til slut.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 5 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: D, A, D, A. Lad armen vippe mellem de to niveauer.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Fra C til D springer du G-strengen over, så armen bevæger sig mere. Flyt jævnt, og lad ikke den midterste streng lyde.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 2 · lesson vc-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · title

rows.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
rows.translation: Én finger pr. halvtonetrin: spil D-dur og dine første melodier.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 “First position: D and A” · unit summary
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
rows.translation: Et halvtonetrin er musikkens mindste trin. I første position ligger fingrene et halvtonetrin fra hinanden fra et heltonetrin (to halvtonetrin) over den løse streng. Tommelfingeren bag halsen over for anden finger.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Løst D, så E med første finger. Hold E, til tonen er ren.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
rows.translation: Samme finger på A-strengen: løst A, så B.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
rows.translation: Løst D, så E. Hvor langt imellem?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: First finger on D and A
rows.translation: Første finger på D og A
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-1 “First finger: E” · step 7 (along) · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · title
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
rows.translation: Tredje finger spiller F med kryds, et heltonetrin over E. Lad anden finger svæve over sin plads mellem 1 og 3, så hånden beholder formen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
rows.translation: D, E, F med kryds. Hold første finger nede, mens tredje spiller.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Fra E til næste tone: hvilken slags trin?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
rows.translation: Hvorfor bliver anden finger over sin plads?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
rows.translation: Hver finger har et halvtonetrin. Når alle fire bliver på plads, lander hver tone samme sted hver gang.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
rows.translation: Samme fingre på A-strengen: løst A, B, C med kryds.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-2 “Third finger: F sharp” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Fjerde finger spiller G, et halvtonetrin over F med kryds. D, E, F med kryds, G er første halvdel af D-dur-skalaen: løs, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: D, E, F med kryds, G: løs, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G med fjerde finger på D-strengen er en oktav over løs G-streng: samme bogstav, otte toner højere. Når tonen er ren, summer G-strengen med.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G med fjerde finger, løst G, så G med fjerde finger igen. Lyt efter medklangen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-3 “Fourth finger: G” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Spil D, E, F med kryds, G på D-strengen, så A, B, C med kryds, D på A-strengen. Samme fingre to gange: løs, 1, 3, 4.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
rows.translation: Hvilke fingre spiller D-dur på hver streng?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · lesson vc-3-4 “The D major scale” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
rows.translation: Denne franske melodi fra 1700-tallet bruger kun toner, du har lært: D, E, F med kryds, G på D-strengen og A og B på A-strengen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger spiller B på A-strengen?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · song vc-3-5 “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Løs, 1, 3, 4 på D- og A-strengen. Bevar håndformen, land hver tone rent, og lad oktaverne klinge.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Tredje til fjerde finger: hvilken slags trin?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
rows.translation: To oktavtjek: G med løst G, så D med fjerde finger mod løst D.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 3 · challenge vc-3-7 “D and A checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger spiller C med kryds på A-strengen?

Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · title

rows.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
rows.translation: To dybe strenge, C-dur- og G-dur-skalaer og tre klassiske melodier.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 “G and C strings” · unit summary
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
rows.translation: På G-strengen spiller første finger A, tredje finger B og fjerde finger C. Samme afstande som på D. Lad armen falde til ro på G-strengens niveau.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C på G-strengen plus D, E, F med kryds, G på D-strengen danner G-dur-skalaen. Samme fingre på begge strenge.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-1 “The G string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger spiller C på G-strengen?

Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
rows.translation: På C-strengen spiller første finger D, tredje finger E og fjerde finger F. Den tykke streng kræver et langsomt, tungt strøg for at tale.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F: løs, 1, 3, 4. Giv hver tone tid til at tale.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F på C-strengen plus G, A, B, C på G-strengen er C-dur-skalaen. Den har slet ingen krydser.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
rows.translation: Op ad C-dur-skalaen. Lyt øverst efter C, der klinger med den løse C-streng.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-2 “The C string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
rows.translation: Anden finger spiller F uden fortegn på D-strengen, et halvtonetrin under F med kryds, og C uden fortegn på A-strengen. C-dur kræver begge.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
rows.translation: D, E, F, G: løs, 1, 2, 4. Anden finger ligger lige op ad første.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: E, then second finger or third?
rows.translation: E, så anden eller tredje finger?
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
rows.translation: Cellister giver hver finger sit eget halvtonetrin, så F får anden finger og F med kryds tredje. En tone lige uden for hånden, som F med kryds på C-strengen, kræver udvidet håndstilling. Dette kursus vælger tonearter, der undgår den.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
rows.translation: C-dur, anden oktav: anden finger til F og det øverste C.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 4 · lesson vc-4-3 “Second finger: F natural” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
rows.translation: Ode til glæden en oktav op

Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
rows.translation: Brahms skrev denne vuggevise i 1868. Den vugger i tre på G- og D-strengen. Brug lange, langsomme buestrøg, og lad hver frase trække vejret.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
rows.translation: G, F med kryds, E: finger 4, 3, 1. Det er vuggevisens højdepunkt.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-5 “Brahms' Lullaby” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
rows.translation: Au clair de la lune er en fransk folkesang fra 1700-tallet. Den ligger på G- og D-strengen med C under fjerde finger.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
rows.translation: D, C, B, A, G: løst D, så finger 4, 3, 1 og løst G.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 4 · song vc-4-6 “Au clair de la lune” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
rows.translation: Hvilke toner i melodien er løse strenge?

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
rows.translation: Løs, 1, 3, 4 på hver streng, med anden finger til F og C uden fortegn. Langsomme, tunge strøg på de dybe strenge.

Cello · Unit 4 · challenge vc-4-7 “Low strings checkup” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two octave checks: C with open C, then G with open G.
rows.translation: To oktavtjek: C med løst C, så G med løst G.

rows.source: Which of these keys has no sharps?

rows.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
rows.translation: Glid til fjerde position, tjek med øret, og spil Svanen og Amazing Grace.

Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
rows.translation: Et positionsskift flytter hele hånden til et nyt sted på strengen. Let trykket, glid langs strengen uden at løfte, og lad tommelfingeren følge hånden.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
rows.translation: I fjerde position spiller første finger D på A-strengen, tonen som fjerde finger spillede i første position. Tommelfingeren hviler, hvor halsen buer ind mod kroppen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
rows.translation: B med første finger, glid så samme finger op til D. Hold trykket let undervejs.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
rows.translation: At flytte hånden samlet bevarer fingerafstanden, så også de næste toner lander rent.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-1 “Your first shift” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
rows.translation: Skift op, tilbage og op igen på første finger. Land hver tone rent.

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
rows.translation: I fjerde position på A-strengen spiller første finger D, tredje finger E og fjerde finger F. Samme ramme som første position: én finger pr. halvtonetrin.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
rows.translation: D, E, F: finger 1, 3, 4. Heroppe ligger tonerne lidt tættere.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-2 “Fourth position on A” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
rows.translation: Løst A, B, skift på første finger til D, så E med tredje.

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
rows.translation: Hvilken finger spiller E i fjerde position på A-strengen?

rows.source: Up to fourth position and back

rows.source: In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
rows.translation: I fjerde position på D-strengen spiller første finger G og tredje A, samme tone som løs A-streng. Spil dem efter hinanden, og få dem til at matche.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
rows.translation: G med første finger, så A med tredje, begge på D-strengen.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · lesson vc-5-3 “Fourth position on D” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
rows.translation: A i fjerde position, løst A, A i fjerde position. Få samme lyd.

rows.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
rows.translation: Spil E med første finger i første position, og glid så samme finger op til G. Det er tre halvtonetrin, samme afstand som B til D på A-strengen.

rows.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
rows.translation: E med første finger, glid så til G med første finger. Lad også tommelfingeren flytte.

rows.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
rows.translation: Svanen er fra Dyrenes karneval, skrevet af Camille Saint-Saëns i 1886. Her er åbningsfrasen, en oktav dybere og forenklet.

rows.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
rows.translation: Lange toner kræver langsomme strøg. Hold buen tæt på stolen, og fordel den jævnt, så hver tone varer helt til slut uden at svinde.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · song vc-5-4 “The Swan” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
rows.translation: G, F med kryds, B: fjerde og tredje finger på D, så tredje finger på G.

rows.source: In Amazing Grace, the high D comes right after open A. While the A rings, slide your hand up to fourth position and land on D with first finger.
rows.translation: I Amazing Grace kommer det høje D lige efter løst A. Mens A klinger, glider hånden op til fjerde position og lander på D med første finger.

rows.source: B, open A, then first-finger D in fourth position. Move while the A sounds.
rows.translation: B, løst A, så D med første finger i fjerde position. Flyt, mens A klinger.

rows.translation: Mens en løs streng klinger, er venstre hånd fri, så skiftet ikke kan høres.

rows.source: Lighten the finger, move hand and thumb together, and check where you land. The open strings will tell you if you're right.
rows.translation: Let fingertrykket, flyt hånd og tommelfinger sammen, og tjek landingen. De løse strenge fortæller dig, om du rammer.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Fourth-position A on the D string, then open A. Match them.
rows.translation: A i fjerde position på D-strengen, så løst A. Få dem til at matche.
rows.context: Cello · Unit 5 · challenge vc-5-6 “Shifting checkup” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In fourth position, which note does first finger play on the A string?
rows.translation: Hvilken tone spiller første finger på A-strengen i fjerde position?

rows.source: From paired strings to fiddle tunes and the bluegrass chop
rows.translation: Fra parvise strenge til spillemandsmelodier og bluegrass-chop
rows.context: Mandolin course · course subtitle
Mandolin · Unit 1 “Hello, mandolin” · title

rows.source: Meet the paired strings, tune them and play all four open notes.
rows.translation: Mød strengparrene, stem dem, og spil alle fire løse toner.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 “Hello, mandolin” · unit summary

rows.source: A mandolin has eight strings in four pairs, called courses. The two strings of a pair are tuned to the same note and played together, so you treat each pair as one string.
rows.translation: En mandolin har otte strenge i fire par, kaldet kor. De to strenge i et par stemmes til samme tone og spilles sammen, så du behandler hvert par som én streng.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The pair nearest your face is the lowest, pair 4. The pair nearest the floor is the highest, pair 1. When a lesson says string 3, it means the third pair.
rows.translation: Parret nærmest ansigtet er dybest, par 4. Parret nærmest gulvet er højest, par 1. Når en lektion siger streng 3, betyder det tredje par.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you play a pair?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Both strings at once, as one note
rows.translation: Begge strenge på én gang som én tone
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The two strings sit close together, so one pick stroke catches both. Together they ring as one fuller note.
rows.translation: De to strenge ligger tæt, så ét plekteranslag rammer begge. Sammen klinger de som én fyldigere tone.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pick the lowest pair, pair 4, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Slå det dybeste par an, par 4, og lad det klinge.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-1 “Meet your mandolin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each pair has to match the tuner and match itself. If its two strings disagree, you hear a slow wobble. Tune one string, then bring its partner to the same note.
rows.translation: Hvert par skal passe til stemmeren og hinanden. Er de to strenge uenige, hører du langsom bølgen. Stem én streng, og bring så partneren til samme tone.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3, the D pair. Tune both strings until the wobble stops.
rows.translation: Par 3, D-parret. Stem begge strenge, til bølgen stopper.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: One pair has a slow wobble. What is wrong?
rows.translation: Et par bølger langsomt. Hvad er galt?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: That wobble is called beating: the two strings are slightly apart. Tune them until it smooths out.
rows.translation: Den bølgen kaldes svævninger: de to strenge er lidt fra hinanden. Stem dem, til lyden bliver jævn.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Loosen a little below the note, then tighten up to it. Approaching from below keeps the string from slipping flat later.
rows.translation: Løsn lidt under tonen, og stram så op til den. At nærme sig nedefra hindrer strengen i senere at glide for lavt.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, then pair 1. Bring each string up to the note from below.
rows.translation: Par 4, så par 1. Bring hver streng op til tonen nedefra.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-2 “Tune the pairs” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Hold the pick between the pad of your thumb and the side of your curled index finger. Let only the tip show. Keep your wrist loose, as if shaking water off your hand.
rows.translation: Hold plektret mellem tommelfingerpuden og siden af den bøjede pegefinger. Kun spidsen skal stikke ud. Hold håndleddet løst, som når du ryster vand af hånden.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How much of the pick should show?
rows.translation: Hvor meget af plektret skal stikke ud?

rows.source: A short tip gives you control and a clean sound. Too much pick snags on the paired strings.
rows.translation: En kort spids giver kontrol og ren lyd. For meget plekter hænger fast i strengparrene.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Push the pick down through both strings of a pair in one small motion and stop just past them. Rest the heel of your hand lightly near the bridge.
rows.translation: Tryk plektret ned gennem begge strenge i parret i én lille bevægelse, og stop lige efter. Hvil håndroden let nær stolen.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-3 “Hold the pick” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: From low to high, the pairs are G, D, A and E. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat. A violin is tuned the same way, so fiddle tunes sit naturally on a mandolin.
rows.translation: Fra dyb til høj er parrene G, D, A og E. Prøv: Glade Dyr Arbejder Energisk. En violin er stemt på samme måde, så spillemandsmelodier ligger naturligt på mandolin.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · lesson man-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Low to high: G, D, A, E.
rows.translation: Fra dyb til høj: G, D, A, E.

rows.source: Now high to low: E, A, D, G.
rows.translation: Nu fra høj til dyb: E, A, D, G.

rows.source: Tuned pairs, a relaxed pick and four open notes. Play each one cleanly, with both strings of the pair ringing.
rows.translation: Stemte par, afslappet plekter og fire løse toner. Spil hver rent med begge strenge i parret klingende.

rows.source: Pairs count from the highest, pair 1, to the lowest, pair 4.
rows.translation: Parrene tælles fra det højeste, par 1, til det dybeste, par 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · challenge man-1-5 “Open-string challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A, G, E, D. Find each pair by its name.
rows.translation: A, G, E, D. Find hvert par ud fra navnet.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D pair: open D, E at fret 2 with your first finger, and F sharp at fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb ligger på D-parret: løst D, E på bånd 2 med første finger og F med kryds på bånd 4 med anden.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 2, first finger. That's E.
rows.translation: Par 3, bånd 2, første finger. Det er E.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 4, second finger. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Par 3, bånd 4, anden finger. Det er F med kryds.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 1 · song man-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Fret notes cleanly, learn two frets per finger and play the D major scale.
rows.translation: Grib tonerne rent, lær to bånd pr. finger, og spil D-dur-skalaen.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 “First notes” · unit summary

rows.source: Press both strings of a pair with one fingertip, just behind the metal fret. Mandolin strings are tight, so use the very tip and press only as hard as a clean note needs.
rows.translation: Tryk begge strenge i et par med én fingerspids lige bag metalbåndet. Mandolinstrenge er stramme, så brug spidsen, og tryk kun så hårdt, som en ren tone kræver.

rows.source: Right behind the fret takes the least pressure and gives the cleanest note.
rows.translation: Lige bag båndet kræves mindst tryk, og tonen bliver renest.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-1 “Your first fretted notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.translation: Løs, bånd 2, bånd 4: D, E, F♯.

rows.source: Mandolin frets are close together, so each finger covers two. First finger plays frets 1 and 2, second finger 3 and 4, third finger 5 and 6, little finger 7.
rows.translation: Mandolinens bånd ligger tæt, så hver finger dækker to. Første finger spiller bånd 1 og 2, anden finger 3 og 4, tredje finger 5 og 6, lillefinger 7.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Each finger covers two frets on mandolin, so the second finger handles frets 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Hver finger dækker to bånd på mandolin, så anden finger tager bånd 3 og 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The A pair works the same way: open is A, fret 2 is B, fret 4 is C♯ and fret 5 is D. Your hand stays where it is.
rows.translation: A-parret virker på samme måde: løs er A, bånd 2 er B, bånd 4 er C♯, og bånd 5 er D. Hånden bliver, hvor den er.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · lesson man-2-2 “One finger, two frets” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open, then first, second and third fingers on pair 2.
rows.translation: Løs, så første, anden og tredje finger på par 2.

rows.source: Join the two shapes and you have the D major scale: D, E, F♯, G on pair 3, then A, B, C♯, D on pair 2. It is home for a great many fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Saml de to greb, så har du D-dur-skalaen: D, E, F♯, G på par 3, så A, B, C♯, D på par 2. Den er hjem for mange spillemandsmelodier.

rows.source: Beethoven's melody uses only the first five notes of D major, on pairs 3 and 2. Keep your fingers hovering close to the strings between notes.
rows.translation: Beethovens melodi bruger kun de første fem toner i D-dur på par 3 og 2. Lad fingrene svæve tæt over strengene mellem tonerne.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 2 · song man-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F♯ and G on pair 3, then the open A pair.
rows.translation: F♯ og G på par 3, så det løse A-par.

rows.translation: Finger et, to og tre på bånd 2, 4 og 5 med løse par imellem. Spil glidende, og lad hver tone klinge til den næste.

rows.source: Every other note of the scale: D, F♯, A, D.
rows.translation: Hver anden skalatone: D, F♯, A, D.

rows.source: On pair 2, fret 2 is B, fret 3 is C and fret 4 is C♯.

rows.source: Down on the beat and up in between keeps your hand in time, like a drummer's sticks.
rows.translation: Ned på slaget og op imellem holder hånden i takt som trommestikker.

rows.source: When you move to another pair, your hand keeps its down-up swing. The forearm carries you across; the wrist keeps the beat.
rows.translation: Når du flytter til et andet par, fortsætter hånden ned-op. Underarmen flytter dig på tværs; håndleddet holder pulsen.

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke. Let the pendulum decide, not the string.
rows.translation: Hvert og får et opslag. Lad pendulet bestemme, ikke strengen.

rows.source: A mandolin note fades quickly. Tremolo keeps it singing: pick down and up fast and evenly on one pair, so the note sounds unbroken.
rows.translation: En mandolintone svinder hurtigt. Tremolo holder den syngende: slå hurtigt og jævnt ned og op på ét par, så tonen lyder ubrudt.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 2 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 3 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Keep the pick close to the strings and the strokes even. Speed comes later, once the motion is relaxed.
rows.translation: Hold plektret tæt på strengene og anslagene jævne. Farten kommer senere, når bevægelsen er afslappet.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Start by counting four strokes to each beat. As it gets easier, stop counting and keep the motion quick and steady. The beat lives in your foot, not in your pick.
rows.translation: Start med at tælle fire anslag pr. slag. Når det bliver lettere, så stop tællingen, og hold bevægelsen hurtig og jævn. Pulsen bor i foden, ikke i plektret.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 3 · lesson man-3-3 “Tremolo” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Amazing Grace moves in three beats to the bar. Tremolo through each long note and change notes right on the beat. Two notes are new: A and B on the G pair.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace går i tre slag pr. takt. Spil tremolo gennem hver lang tone, og skift toner på slaget. To toner er nye: A og B på G-parret.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, fret 2 with your first finger, then fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Par 4, bånd 2 med første finger, så bånd 4 med anden.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: How do you hold the long A at the end?
rows.translation: Hvordan holder du det lange A til sidst?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Slå an én gang, og vent
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A single pick fades long before three beats are up. Tremolo keeps it ringing to the end of the bar.
rows.translation: Et enkelt anslag svinder længe før tre slag er gået. Tremolo holder tonen i gang til taktens slutning.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · song man-3-4 “Amazing Grace” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · title
Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Down on the beat, up in between, and tremolo whenever a note needs to last. Keep every stroke small.
rows.translation: Ned på slaget, op imellem og tremolo, når en tone skal vare. Hold hvert anslag lille.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which stroke plays the and of beat 2?
rows.translation: Hvilket anslag spiller og efter slag 2?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Every and gets an up stroke, wherever the note is.
rows.translation: Hvert og får et opslag, uanset hvor tonen ligger.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 3 · challenge man-3-5 “Picking challenge” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 “Chords and the chop” · title

rows.source: G, D, C, E minor and A, then the short, choked chord that drives bluegrass.
rows.translation: G, D, C, E-mol og A, så den korte, afklemte akkord, der driver bluegrass.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 “Chords and the chop” · unit summary
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 2, second finger on fret 3 of pair 1. Pairs 4 and 3 ring open.
rows.translation: Første finger på bånd 2 på par 2, anden finger på bånd 3 på par 1. Par 4 og 3 klinger løst.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Brush the pick down across all four pairs in one smooth motion, low to high. Small and light is enough; mandolin chords are bright.
rows.translation: Stryg plektret ned over alle fire par i én jævn bevægelse fra dyb til høj. Småt og let er nok; mandolinakkorder er lyse.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 4, second finger on fret 2 of pair 1. Pairs 3 and 2 ring open.
rows.translation: Første finger på bånd 2 på par 4, anden finger på bånd 2 på par 1. Par 3 og 2 klinger løst.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-1 “G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of pair 3, second finger on fret 3 of pair 2. Pairs 4 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Første finger på bånd 2 på par 3, anden finger på bånd 3 på par 2. Par 4 og 1 klinger løst.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: From C, slide your second finger back to fret 2. The chord turns darker, though only one finger moved.
rows.translation: Fra C lader du anden finger glide tilbage til bånd 2. Akkorden bliver mørkere, selv om kun én finger flyttede.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-2 “C and E minor” · step 6 (listen) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fret 2 on pairs 4 and 3, fret 4 on pair 2, fret 5 on pair 1: fingers one, two, three and four. No pair rings open.
rows.translation: Bånd 2 på par 4 og 3, bånd 4 på par 2, bånd 5 på par 1: finger et, to, tre og fire. Intet par klinger løst.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Why does it matter that no pair rings open?
rows.translation: Hvorfor betyder det noget, at intet par klinger løst?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: You can silence it by easing off
rows.translation: Du kan stoppe lyden ved at slippe trykket
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It keeps the chord in tune
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: With every pair held down, relaxing your fingers stops the sound at once. That is the secret of the chop.
rows.translation: Når alle par holdes nede, stopper lyden straks, når fingrene slapper af. Det er hemmeligheden bag chop.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-3 “A: four fingers” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The chop is a short chord on beats 2 and 4. Strum down, then ease your fretting fingers off the strings without lifting them, so the sound stops right away.
rows.translation: Chop er en kort akkord på slag 2 og 4. Slå ned, og slip så gribefingrenes tryk uden at løfte dem, så lyden stopper straks.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bass and guitar take beats 1 and 3. The mandolin answers on 2 and 4, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Bas og guitar tager slag 1 og 3. Mandolinen svarer på 2 og 4 som en lilletromme.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let the chord sound for only a moment. If it hangs on, relax your fingers sooner. Your fingertips stay touching the strings the whole time.
rows.translation: Lad kun akkorden lyde et øjeblik. Hænger den ved, så slap tidligere af i fingrene. Fingerspidserne rører strengene hele tiden.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-4 “The chop” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Chops in G, C and D
rows.translation: Chops i G, C og D
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your A shape works anywhere on the neck. Slide it up three frets for C and five frets for D. Keep all four fingers in place as you move.
rows.translation: Dit A-greb virker overalt på halsen. Skub det tre bånd op til C og fem bånd op til D. Hold alle fire fingre på plads, mens du flytter.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: G needs a new stretch: first finger fret 2 on pair 2, second finger fret 3 on pair 1, third finger fret 5 on pair 3, little finger fret 7 on pair 4.
rows.translation: G kræver et nyt stræk: første finger bånd 2 på par 2, anden finger bånd 3 på par 1, tredje finger bånd 5 på par 3, lillefinger bånd 7 på par 4.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · lesson man-4-5 “Chops in G, C and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · title
Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum open chords to learn the sound, then chop on 2 and 4 to drive the band. Keep the beat steady through every change.
rows.translation: Slå åbne akkorder an for at lære lyden, og spil så chop på 2 og 4 for at drive bandet. Hold pulsen jævn gennem hvert skift.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your chop keeps ringing. What fixes it?
rows.translation: Dit chop klinger videre. Hvad retter det?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lift your fingers off the neck
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ease off with your fretting fingers sooner
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The chop is choked by the fretting hand. Relax the pressure but keep your fingertips on the strings.
rows.translation: Choppet kvæles med gribehånden. Slip trykket, men behold fingerspidserne på strengene.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 4 · challenge man-4-6 “Bluegrass backup” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 “Fiddle tunes” · title

rows.source: Five traditional jam tunes, simplified, from Boil Them Cabbage Down to Old Joe Clark.
rows.translation: Fem traditionelle jammelodier, forenklet, fra Boil Them Cabbage Down til Old Joe Clark.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 “Fiddle tunes” · unit summary
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This one lives on the E and A pairs and keeps coming back to F♯. Pick down on the beat and up in between, just like your eighth-note drills.
rows.translation: Denne ligger på E- og A-parret og vender hele tiden tilbage til F♯. Slå ned på slaget og op imellem, ligesom i ottendedelsøvelserne.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: F♯, G and A on pair 1 at frets 2, 3 and 5, then D on pair 2, fret 5.
rows.translation: F♯, G og A på par 1 ved bånd 2, 3 og 5, så D på par 2, bånd 5.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the tune come to rest?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Like most tunes in D, it ends on D, the home note.
rows.translation: Som de fleste melodier i D slutter den på D, hjemmetonen.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The low part of Angeline the Baker uses only D, E, F♯, A and B. Both parts end on A instead of D, which sends the tune around again.
rows.translation: Den dybe del af Angeline the Baker bruger kun D, E, F♯, A og B. Begge dele slutter på A i stedet for D, så melodien tager endnu en omgang.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 2 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which note do both parts end on?
rows.translation: Hvilken tone slutter begge dele på?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Ending on A instead of D leaves the tune hanging, so it rolls straight into the next time through.
rows.translation: At slutte på A i stedet for D lader melodien hænge, så den ruller direkte videre til næste omgang.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-2 “Angeline the Baker” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was in print in Scotland by 1780 and has filled American jams ever since. Its first part bounces between D, F♯ and A.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy var trykt i Skotland senest i 1780 og har fyldt amerikanske jams lige siden. Første del hopper mellem D, F♯ og A.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Open A pair, pair 3 fret 4, open D, then fret 4 again.
rows.translation: Løst A-par, par 3 bånd 4, løst D, så bånd 4 igen.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: D, F♯ and A together spell which chord?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord danner D, F♯ og A sammen?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D, F♯ and A are the three notes of D major. Fiddle tunes often trace their chords like this.
rows.translation: D, F♯ og A er de tre toner i D-dur. Spillemandsmelodier følger ofte deres akkorder sådan.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-3 “Soldier's Joy” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler starts low, down on the G pair, then jumps up to the E pair for a part that tumbles down the scale. It was in print by the 1840s.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler starter dybt på G-parret og springer så op til E-parret til en del, der tumler ned ad skalaen. Den var trykt senest i 1840'erne.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, frets 2 and 4, then the open D pair.
rows.translation: Par 4, bånd 2 og 4, så det løse D-par.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the high part begin?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On A, fret 5 of the E pair
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It opens on A at fret 5 of pair 1, then walks down through G, F♯ and E.
rows.translation: Den åbner på A ved bånd 5 på par 1 og går så ned gennem G, F♯ og E.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: A new key and a twist
rows.translation: En ny toneart og et twist
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A, so you use C♯ and G♯. In the second part, G♯ drops to plain G on fret 3 of the E pair. That one note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark er i A, så du bruger C♯ og G♯. I anden del sænkes G♯ til almindeligt G på bånd 3 på E-parret. Den ene tone giver melodiens oldtime-lyd.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G♯ on pair 3, fret 6; the open A pair; then G on pair 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: G♯ på par 3, bånd 6; det løse A-par; så G på par 1, bånd 3.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time sound?
rows.translation: Hvilken tone giver anden del dens oldtime-lyd?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A major uses G♯. Lowering it to G gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: A-dur bruger G♯. At sænke den til G giver den mixolydiske lyd, der præger oldtime og bluegrass.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · title
Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play each tune through at a steady tempo. If a note slips, keep your picking hand moving and catch the next beat. That is how real jams work.
rows.translation: Spil hver melodi igennem i jævnt tempo. Glipper en tone, så hold anslagshånden i gang, og fang næste slag. Sådan virker rigtige jams.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which tune swaps G♯ for G?
rows.translation: Hvilken melodi bytter G♯ ud med G?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A but uses G in its second part. That lowered note is its signature.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark er i A, men bruger G i anden del. Den sænkede tone er dens kendetegn.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 6 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 “Slides, hammers and crosspicking” · title

rows.source: Add the left-hand moves and rolling right hand that make a tune sound like bluegrass.
rows.translation: Tilføj venstrehåndsgreb og rullende højrehånd, der giver en melodi bluegrasslyd.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 “Slides, hammers and crosspicking” · unit summary

rows.source: Pick a note, then keep pressing as you glide the same finger up to a higher fret. The new note sounds without a second pick stroke. Light, steady pressure is the trick.
rows.translation: Slå en tone an, og hold så trykket, mens samme finger glider op til et højere bånd. Den nye tone lyder uden et nyt anslag. Let, jævnt tryk er tricket.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: What sounds the second note in a slide?
rows.translation: Hvad frembringer anden tone i et slide?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your finger pressing as it moves
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressure on the string as you slide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Kun første tone slås an. Hold trykket på strengen, mens du glider, ellers dør tonen undervejs.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 4 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · title

rows.source: Pick an open pair, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick stroke.
rows.translation: Slå et løst par an, og slå så en fingerspids ned lige bag bånd 2. Den nye tone lyder af slaget alene, uden et nyt plekteranslag.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: The reverse: with a finger on fret 2, pick, then pull the finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open note below.
rows.translation: Omvendt: slå an med en finger på bånd 2, og træk så fingeren lidt sidelæns, mens du løfter. Vippet knipser den løse tone nedenunder.

rows.translation: Alle tre frembringer en anden tone med gribehånden. Plektret spiller kun den første.

rows.source: Fiddle tunes come alive with small ornaments. Here the two plain A notes that open Old Joe Clark become A, B, A: a hammer-on and a pull-off.
rows.translation: Spillemandsmelodier får liv med små forsiringer. Her bliver de to almindelige A-toner i starten af Old Joe Clark til A, B, A: et hammer-on og et pull-off.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In A, B, A, how many times do you pick?
rows.translation: Hvor mange gange slår du an i A, B, A?

rows.source: Pick the first A, hammer on to B and pull off back to A. One pick, three notes.
rows.translation: Slå første A an, lav hammer-on til B og pull-off tilbage til A. Ét anslag, tre toner.

rows.source: Crosspicking picks single notes across three pairs in a repeating pattern, so a chord sounds like a ripple. Eight notes split three, three and two.
rows.translation: Crosspicking spiller enkelttoner over tre par i et gentaget mønster, så akkorden lyder som en bølge. Otte toner deles i tre, tre og to.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How are the eight notes of a crosspicking bar grouped?
rows.translation: Hvordan grupperes de otte toner i en takt crosspicking?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A three-note pattern repeated across a bar of eight makes the accent shift each time. That is the rolling feel.
rows.translation: Et tretonemønster gentaget gennem en takt med otte flytter betoningen hver gang. Det giver den rullende fornemmelse.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Slides, hammer-ons, chops and crosspicking. Take each one at your own pace, and keep the beat steady above all.
rows.translation: Slides, hammer-ons, chops og crosspicking. Tag dem i dit eget tempo, og hold frem for alt pulsen jævn.

rows.source: Five-string, open G: rolls, old-time tunes and clawhammer
rows.translation: Fem strenge, åbent G: rolls, oldtime og clawhammer
rows.context: Banjo course · course subtitle

rows.source: Meet the five strings, tune to open G, find the drone string and play a song.
rows.translation: Mød de fem strenge, stem til åbent G, find bordunstrengen, og spil en sang.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 “Hello, banjo” · unit summary

Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A banjo has four full-length strings and a fifth that starts partway up the neck, at its own little tuning peg. That short string is the banjo's signature sound.
rows.translation: En banjo har fire strenge i fuld længde og en femte, som starter et stykke oppe ad halsen ved sin egen lille stemmeskrue. Den korte streng er banjoens særlige lyd.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: String 1 is the thin one nearest the floor. Strings 2, 3 and 4 follow toward your face. The short one on top is string 5.
rows.translation: Streng 1 er den tynde nærmest gulvet. Streng 2, 3 og 4 følger mod ansigtet. Den korte øverst er streng 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string is the short one?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The fifth string lies next to string 4 but starts at the fifth fret, with its peg on the side of the neck.
rows.translation: Femte streng ligger ved siden af streng 4, men starter ved femte bånd med skruen på halsens side.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the thin one nearest the floor.
rows.translation: Knips streng 1, den tynde nærmest gulvet.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the short string, string 5. Pluck it with your thumb.
rows.translation: Nu den korte streng, streng 5. Knips med tommelfingeren.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Standard banjo tuning is open G. From string 4 to string 1 it reads D, G, B, D, and the short fifth string is a high G. Strummed open, they make a G chord.
rows.translation: Standardstemning på banjo er åbent G. Fra streng 4 til streng 1 hedder tonerne D, G, B, D, og den korte femte streng er et højt G. Slået løst an danner de en G-akkord.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Strings 4, 3, 2 and 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.translation: Streng 4, 3, 2 og 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What chord do the open strings make?
rows.translation: Hvilken akkord danner de løse strenge?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G chord. That is why this tuning is called open G.
rows.translation: G, B og D er tonerne i en G-akkord. Derfor kaldes stemningen åbent G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
